messages:
noah: brought my desk guest today  meet Pepper, my bearded dragon. she is reclaiming the succulent as her throne. pic: https://i.imgur.com/Pepper1.jpg :lizard:
tara: omg tiny crown. does she accept coffee? :joy:
jules: absolute royalty. also surprised how chill beardies are. can she approve PRs?
mike: quick care note: pepper likes 95F basking spot and will judge you if pants are not lizard-friendly.
noah: heater setup flex (for science): 
```
heat lamp: 100W
thermostat target: 95F
timer: 12pm-2pm (office naps)
```
noah: bonus pic of the snooze pose: https://i.imgur.com/Pepper2.jpg (note: dramatic flail leg)
tara: that flail is performance art. 100% would do a town hall cameo.
jules: poll: should we have an "exotic pet show-and-tell" next Friday? reply yes/no
mike: yes from me, i will bring my houseplant and let Pepper inspect it. :seedling:
noah: lol Pepper insists on doing an official inspection of all laptops before meetings.
ops-bot: reminder: please follow the office pet policy for non-dog animals and make sure Pepper's enclosure is secure during transit. :info:
tara: tiny audio: soft huff when offered a piece of carrot. will upload in thread.
jules: caption idea: "When you run the company and also the thermostat."
noah: end of shift update: Pepper gave a slow blink to the ficus, approved team vibes. closing pic: https://i.imgur.com/Pepper3.jpg :heart:
